title: Noether R341 Paper 24 p232 source-left equation-tag layout fix
scope: Paper 24, printed/source p.232, transformation displays (1) and (1').
summary: R341 applies one narrowly scoped German cumulative TeX layout/source-style patch in Paper 24 printed p.232. The transformation displays labelled (1) and (1') are converted from right-tagged align displays with comma/quad separators to the project source-left `\srcnumdisplay` form with compact semicolon-separated transformation clauses, matching the visible source layout while preserving the mathematical content. The package reports a successful two-pass XeLaTeX build of the 474-page cumulative.
